name: Any provider
note: Bring your own keys and endpoint
summary: The stack can reach models through whichever provider or gateway you configure: a lab's own API, an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, a router such as OpenRouter or LiteLLM, or a local server.
how: Point the agent at a base URL and key, or pick a built-in provider
Optionally put a gateway in front for fallbacks, spend limits and logging
facts: Stacks whose docs list many providers or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint
watchOut: You own key management, rate limits and failover unless you add a gateway
